patch_list: Blocks Firebase Analytics and Crashlytics, Quantum Metric session replay, AppsFlyer, Synerise event tracking and sponsored offer reporting.
Stops the popup asking to turn on notifications.
Removes the offer carousels from the home screen.
Removes the Instagram-style stories row at the top of the home screen.
